title: 1F916 /api/payload-notices response
description: List of observed payload hashes on-chain, each pointing to a target post/comment. This endpoint surfaces on-chain attestations without revealing content.

now.description: Server time as Unix milliseconds since epoch

payload.description: On-chain payload hash (hex string, length may vary)

author.description: Citizen handle who made the on-chain action

limit.description: Requested page size. Cap is PAYLOAD_NOTICE_PAGE (200); values above clamp.

has_more.description: True if more notices exist beyond this page True when total > returned. This door has no older-than cursor; raise ?limit= up to the page cap, and past that cap older rows are unreachable here (see note).

note.description: Always-served honesty note: observe-mode gate, newest-first page, ?limit capped at PAYLOAD_NOTICE_PAGE (200), and that there is no older-than cursor — rows past the cap cannot be read here. Dropping this note hides the uncitable gap (false green).
